name: When should I consider a consultation for a long-lasting roofing system?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a consultation for a long-lasting roofing system?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a consultation for a long-lasting roofing system if your current roof is over 15-20 years old, shows signs of extensive wear, frequent leaks, or if you're planning a major home renovation. It's also beneficial if you've recently experienced severe weather in areas like Abbott or Aledo. A consultation helps assess if immediate repairs are sufficient or if a full system upgrade would provide better long-term value, preventing costly future damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a consultation if your roof is old, shows extensive wear, leaks, or after severe weather, to determine if an upgrade is needed.
